function mediaSlugSeq(seen, label): string

Defined in: core/utils/string.ts:197

Assigns the canonical deep-link slug for one media item within a project's traversal. Distinct captions can collapse to the same slug ("Fórum 2020, Full page" vs "Fórum 2020: Full Page"), which used to silently drop the second item's indexable URL everywhere. The first occurrence keeps the base slug; later ones gain -2, -3, … in document order — every labelled item stays uniquely addressable. Callers iterate items in traversal order sharing one seen map; the same map/count convention is mirrored in the build scripts (generate-sitemap.js + build-locale-pages.mjs) so emitted file names, sitemap s and runtime resolution agree.

Parameters

seen

Map<string, number>

Per-project base-slug → assigned-count map (mutated).

label

string

The item's caption.

Returns

string

The item's unique deep-link slug ('' when unslugifiable).
